name: Do I need a permit for partition wall framing in Denver or nearby suburbs?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for partition wall framing in Denver or nearby suburbs?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the key local issue is whether your project changes the floor plan or involves structural work. A simple non-load-bearing partition may be straightforward, but anything involving load-bearing changes or utilities needs a closer permit and inspection check.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local permit rules can change based on whether the wall is structural or involves utilities. In the Denver metro area, it’s smart to verify requirements before framing begins.
